# OfficeBazzar — Corporate Workplace Procurement & B2B Supplies

> Officebazzar E-Store Private Limited is South India's premier B2B procurement platform for corporate office supplies, Diversey Taski housekeeping chemicals, mobile garbage bins, laser printer toner cartridges, and packaging materials.

## Core Workplace Categories
- [Office Stationery](https://officebazzar.com/category/office-stationery): Files, folders, registers, writing instruments, desk essentials, and desktop stationery.
- [Housekeeping & Hygiene](https://officebazzar.com/category/housekeeping-hygiene): Taski cleaning chemicals, floor cleaning machines, wheeled dustbins, and tissue napkins.
- [Printers & Technology](https://officebazzar.com/category/printers-technology): Laser toner cartridges, barcode printers, paper shredders, and currency counting machines.
- [Packaging Supplies](https://officebazzar.com/category/packaging-supplies): BOPP packing tape, floor marking tapes, strapping rolls, and dispatch materials.
